subject: Draft: Compact MAP + 21d Eval Timeline for HelioMed
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Navarro <alex.navarro@heliomed.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 09:12 AM PST
Subject: Draft: Compact MAP + 21d Eval Timeline for HelioMed

Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our conversation, I put together a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on a tight evaluation path and clear acceptance criteria. The current draft assumes a 21-day evaluation (tech validation + small production-like pilot) but I added a 14-day variant on sheet two for teams that want an accelerated window.

High level:
- Week 0 (Day 0–3): Access, test data ingest, and smoke tests
- Week 1 (Day 4–10): Latency/cost validation on representative queries + integration checklist
- Week 2 (Day 11–17): Feature gating and acceptance tests with key stakeholders
- Week 3 (Day 18–21): Final QA, rollback plan, and decision meeting

What I need from you: quick feedback on milestone owners (highlighted in yellow) and whether the 21-day or 14-day path looks better operationally for HelioMed. If it helps, I can host a 30-minute co-edit session to walk the doc with your engineering & security leads and lock owners.

Attachments: compact-MAP-template-v1.gdoc (link), MAP-slide-skeleton-v1.pptx (slide outline you can re-use in your internal deck)

Link to doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CompactMAPHelioMed
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/HMD-1234

Thanks — let me know what day/time works this week.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Alex Navarro <alex.navarro@heliomed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 11:05 AM PST
Subject: Re: Draft: Compact MAP + 21d Eval Timeline for HelioMed

Marissa —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear milestones. A few notes from HelioMed ops:
- Would prefer the 14-day path if we can compress the integration checklist and run parallel validation steps.
- Security will need SOC2 evidence and a short data flow diagram before day 3 (can your team share the SOC2 summary + where audit logs are surfaced?).
- Can we shift the decision meeting to Day 15 rather than Day 21 if things look good?

If you can adjust the MAP to a 14-day variant and include a one-page security appendix, that would speed internal approvals. I can pull in our SecOps lead (cc: pending until we confirm a time).

Thanks — available Wed 10–11am PT for a working session.

—
Alex Navarro
Director of Platform Engineering | HelioMed
alex.navarro@heliomed.com | +1 206-555-0123

Thanks — good feedback. I created a 14-day condensed variant at the top of the doc and added a one-page security appendix with our SOC 2 summary + endpoints for audit logs and retention. See section "Security Appendix (HelioMed)" page 4.

I also attached a slide skeleton you can drop into your internal briefing (MAP-slide-skeleton-v1.pptx). Proposed working session: Wednesday, Nov 4, 10:00–10:30 AM PT — I'll set a calendar invite and share co-edit access to the GDoc so your SecOps lead can comment inline.

Quick notes on adjustments I made:
- Parallelized integration + validation tasks (Tasks 2 & 3) so Day 4–10 covers both infra + functional checks.
- Decision checkpoint moved to Day 15 with a fast rollback plan if criteria not met.
- Milestone owners: Engineering (Alex) — integration; CS (Jasmine) — acceptance tests; Product (Evelyn) — success criteria signoff.

Doc link (same doc with version notes): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CompactMAPHelioMed
Calendar invite will follow.
